rows.label: bf02070100_0010
rows.name: I see. So you two are off to Eden.

rows.label: bf02070100_0020
rows.name:
I never properly thanked you.
Thanks for saving us.

rows.label: bf02070100_0030
rows.name:
Byakko said that you...
carried us all the way here.

rows.label: bf02070100_0040
rows.name: Divine Beast-sama, thank you very much.

rows.label: bf02070100_0050
rows.name:
No need to thank me. After all,
you were the ones who saved Rex.

rows.label: bf02070100_0060
rows.name: Don't mention it.

rows.label: bf02070100_0070
rows.name:
Still, Divine Beasts really
are convenient, aren't they?

rows.label: bf02070100_0080
rows.name: Not every Divine Beast can do that...

rows.label: bf02070100_0090
rows.name: Enough with that already.

rows.label: bf02070100_0100
rows.name: Enough, you say...? What's with that attitude?

rows.label: bf02070100_0110
rows.name:
In the first place, this is because
you accepted such a ridiculous job.

rows.label: bf02070100_0120
rows.name:
You said, 'Gramps, just
relax here,' and ran off...

rows.label: bf02070100_0130
rows.name: Okay, okay, I get it! It's all my fault.

rows.label: bf02070100_0140
rows.name: I'm sorry. Really, I'm sorry.

rows.label: bf02070100_0150
rows.name:
You're just apologizing half-heartedly.
You don't look sorry at all.

rows.label: bf02070100_0160
rows.name: I can't do that.

rows.label: bf02070100_0170
rows.name: Why?

rows.label: bf02070100_0180
rows.name:
If I hadn't been there, Homura would have
ended up doing whatever they wanted...

rows.label: bf02070100_0190
rows.name: Rex...

rows.label: bf02070100_0200
rows.name:
Absolutely not.
I can't hand Homura over to people like them.

rows.label: bf02070100_0210
rows.name: [ML:undisp ][ML:Dash ][ML:Dash ]
